P.text: User deposits into GaugeV2; maturityTime[address] is never set on deposit, so the maturity check in _withdraw always passes with default 0
P.evidence_quote: `GaugeV2` never sets `maturityTime[address]` on deposit. The maturity check in `_withdraw` therefore always passes (default 0)

I.text: Withdrawals should be limited by maturity, requiring block.timestamp >= maturityTime[msg.sender]
I.evidence_quote: `require(block.timestamp >= maturityTime[msg.sender], "!MATURE");` this check is completely skipped

V.text: Users can deposit, accrue rewards briefly, and withdraw immediately with no lock, earning rewards unfairly
V.evidence_quote: letting users deposit, accrue rewards briefly, and withdraw immediately with no lock
